morphology.pattern_note: 英语专名，整体记忆，不按马来语词缀拆分。正常书写须大写为 Shirley；所列音标为英式英语读音，具体人名读法以本人习惯为准。

senses.zh_definition: 雪莉；源自英语的人名，也可用作姓氏。属于专有名词。
senses.en_definition: An English given name, commonly feminine, also used as a surname.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas bahasa Inggeris yang digunakan sebagai nama orang, lazimnya perempuan, dan juga sebagai nama keluarga.

etymology.historical_story: Shirley reached personal naming through English surnames derived from place names. A commonly cited interpretation connects Old English scīr, meaning bright, with lēah, a woodland clearing. Charlotte Brontë used Shirley as the title and a character's name in her 1849 novel. In Malay sentences, it remains a personal name rather than a descriptive vocabulary item. [Source](https://www.behindthename.com/name/shirley)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到 Shirley，联想中文人名“雪莉”：先认人名，再记首字母大写；不要拆成马来语词根。
